title: Dplyr
summary: dplyr is an R package whose set of functions are designed to enable dataframe manipulation in an intuitive, user-friendly way. It is one of the core packages of the popular tidyverse set of packages in the R programming language. Developed by Hadley Wickham of RStudio, it is an optimized and distilled version of his plyr package, porting much of the computation to C++. The package features five primary verbs: filter() for extracting rows, select() for subsetting columns, arrange() for sorting rows, mutate() for creating new variables, and summarize() for collapsing values. dplyr abstracts over data storage, working with local data frames and remote database tables via the dbplyr package.
